title: October 4, 1977: India's External Affairs Minister became the first person to address the UN General Assembly in Hindi.

sources.text: WION News - India's vision: When Atal Bihari Vajpayee made iconic speech in Hindi at UNGA
GNT TV - Atal Bihari Vajpayee gave a speech in Hindi for the first time in UN on 4 October 1977 United Nations General Assembly

caption:
October 4, 1977: India's External Affairs Minister became the first person to address the UN General Assembly in Hindi.

As India's External Affairs Minister, Vajpayee broke with decades of English-only precedent at the UN podium, speaking on nuclear disarmament and economic cooperation among developing nations - and invoking the ancient Indian idea of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam, 'the world is one family.'

Decades before 'India's voice at the UN' became a familiar phrase in diplomacy, Vajpayee used the moment to assert that India's own language belonged on the world's biggest diplomatic stage - not just its ideas in someone else's words.

Vajpayee's 1977 speech stands as an early marker of India choosing self-assurance over convention on the global stage - the same instinct a developed India will need by 2047.
